name: Background removal (BEN2) → transparent sprite
description: Phase D export: matte one already-rendered pose to a transparent PNG with BEN2 and save it under its SillyTavern filename. Only BEN2 mattes cleanly on this ComfyUI (see workflows/README.md gotchas); the WAS Image Save 'prefix_as_filename' mode is what yields exact <name>.png instead of <name>_00001_.png.
